        this.id = id;
        this.name = name;
    }

    public CustomerId id() {
        return this.id;
    }

    }

    @Override

        if (this == o) {
            return true;

        if (!(o instanceof Customer other)) {
            return false;
        }
        return java.util.Objects.equals(this.id, other.id);
    }

    @Override

        return java.util.Objects.hashCode(this.id);
    }
}

package koine.generated.sales;

/**
 * In-memory-backed repository for the Customer aggregate root. Inject a persistent AggregateStore to back it with a real datastore; the default in-memory store is runnable in tests.
 */
public final class InMemoryCustomerRepository implements CustomerRepository {
    private final koine.runtime.AggregateStore<CustomerId, Customer> store;

    /**
     * Creates a repository over the default in-memory store.
     */
    public InMemoryCustomerRepository() {
        this(new koine.runtime.InMemoryStore<>(Customer::id));
    }

    /**
     * Creates a repository over the supplied store.
     */
    public InMemoryCustomerRepository(koine.runtime.AggregateStore<CustomerId, Customer> store) {
        this.store = store;
    }

    @Override
    public java.util.Optional<Customer> getById(CustomerId id) {
        return this.store.get(id);
    }

    @Override
    public void add(Customer aggregate) {
        this.store.add(aggregate);
    }

    @Override
    public void update(Customer aggregate) {
        this.store.update(aggregate);
    }

    @Override
    public void remove(CustomerId id) {
        this.store.remove(id);
    }
}

// <auto-generated/>
package koine.generated.sales;

/**
 * In-memory-backed repository for the Order aggregate root. Inject a persistent AggregateStore to back it with a real datastore; the default in-memory store is runnable in tests.
 */
public final class InMemoryOrderRepository implements OrderRepository {
    private final koine.runtime.AggregateStore<OrderId, Order> store;

    /**
     * Creates a repository over the default in-memory store.
     */
    public InMemoryOrderRepository() {
        this(new koine.runtime.InMemoryStore<>(Order::id));
    }

    /**
     * Creates a repository over the supplied store.
     */
    public InMemoryOrderRepository(koine.runtime.AggregateStore<OrderId, Order> store) {
        this.store = store;
    }

    @Override
    public java.util.Optional<Order> getById(OrderId id) {
        return this.store.get(id);
    }

    @Override
    public void add(Order aggregate) {
        this.store.add(aggregate);
    }

    @Override
    public void update(Order aggregate) {
        this.store.update(aggregate);
    }

    @Override
    public java.util.List<Order> byCustomer(CustomerId customer) {
        return this.store.all().stream()
            .filter(entity -> java.util.Objects.equals(entity.customer(), customer))
            .toList();
    }

    @Override
    public java.util.Optional<Order> byRef(String orderRef) {
        return this.store.all().stream()
            .filter(entity -> java.util.Objects.equals(entity.orderRef(), orderRef))
            .findFirst();
    }
}

// ==== koine/generated/sales/IntegrationEventDispatcher.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.generated.sales;

/**
 * Drains the Sales outbox and delivers each integration event to the handler, in order. A handler that throws leaves its row undelivered, so the next run retries it.
 */
public final class IntegrationEventDispatcher {
    private final koine.runtime.OutboxStore outbox;
    private final koine.runtime.IntegrationEventHandler handler;

    public IntegrationEventDispatcher(koine.runtime.OutboxStore outbox, koine.runtime.IntegrationEventHandler handler) {
        this.outbox = outbox;
        this.handler = handler;
    }

    /**
     * Delivers every undelivered outbox row, marking each processed as it goes.
     */
    public void dispatchPending() {
        for (koine.runtime.OutboxMessage message : this.outbox.unprocessed()) {
            this.handler.handle(message);
            this.outbox.markProcessed(message);
        }
    }
}

// ==== koine/generated/sales/UnitOfWork.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.generated.sales;

/**
 * In-memory unit of work over the Sales context's aggregate repositories.
 */
public final class UnitOfWork {
    private final OrderRepository orders;
    private final CustomerRepository customers;
    private final koine.runtime.OutboxStore outbox;
    private final java.util.List<Object> pending = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

    /**
     * Creates a unit of work over a fresh in-memory repository per root and a fresh in-memory outbox.
     */
    public UnitOfWork() {
        this(new InMemoryOrderRepository(), new InMemoryCustomerRepository(), new koine.runtime.InMemoryOutboxStore());
    }

    /**
     * Creates a unit of work over the supplied repositories and outbox.
     */
    public UnitOfWork(OrderRepository orders, CustomerRepository customers, koine.runtime.OutboxStore outbox) {
        this.orders = orders;
        this.customers = customers;
        this.outbox = outbox;
    }

    /**
     * Buffers integrationEvent to be flushed to the outbox on the next saveChanges.
     */
    public void enqueue(Object integrationEvent) {
        this.pending.add(integrationEvent);
    }

    /**
     * Flushes every buffered integration event to the outbox.
     */
    public java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture<Void> saveChanges() {
        for (Object integrationEvent : this.pending) {
            this.outbox.add(koine.runtime.OutboxMessage.of(integrationEvent));
        }
        this.pending.clear();
        return java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);
    }
}

// ==== koine/runtime/AggregateStore.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.runtime;

/**
 * The persistence seam a generated repository sits on. The default {@link InMemoryStore} makes a
 * repository runnable with no wiring; inject another implementation to back it with a real
 * datastore without touching the generated repository.
 *
 * <p>Generated by Koine — do not edit by hand.</p>
 *
 * @param <I> the aggregate root's identity type
 * @param <T> the aggregate root type
 */
public interface AggregateStore<I, T> {
    /** The aggregate with this identity, if stored. */
    java.util.Optional<T> get(I id);

    /** Stores a new aggregate (replacing any with the same identity). */
    void add(T aggregate);

    /** Stores changes to an existing aggregate. */
    void update(T aggregate);

    /** Removes the aggregate with this identity, if present. */
    void remove(I id);

    /** Every stored aggregate, in insertion order, as an unmodifiable snapshot. */
    java.util.List<T> all();
}

// ==== koine/runtime/DomainException.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.runtime;

/**
 * Thrown when a domain invariant is violated. Unchecked ({@code RuntimeException}) so generated
 * value objects, entities, and aggregates can guard their invariants without checked-exception
 * ceremony — the Java analogue of the C# emitter's DomainInvariantViolationException.
 *
 * <p>Generated by Koine — do not edit by hand.</p>
 */
public class DomainException extends RuntimeException {
    public DomainException(String message) {
        super(message);
    }
}

// ==== koine/runtime/InMemoryOutboxStore.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.runtime;

/**
 * The zero-dependency default {@link OutboxStore}: a synchronized, append-ordered list. Runnable
 * in tests out of the box; swap in a datastore-backed implementation for production.
 *
 * <p>Generated by Koine — do not edit by hand.</p>
 */
public final class InMemoryOutboxStore implements OutboxStore {
    private final java.util.List<OutboxMessage> messages = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

    @Override
    public synchronized void add(OutboxMessage message) {
        this.messages.add(message);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized java.util.List<OutboxMessage> unprocessed() {
        return this.messages.stream().filter(m -> !m.processed()).toList();
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void markProcessed(OutboxMessage message) {
        for (int i = 0; i < this.messages.size(); i++) {
            if (this.messages.get(i).id().equals(message.id())) {
                this.messages.set(i, this.messages.get(i).markProcessed());
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}

// ==== koine/runtime/InMemoryStore.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.runtime;

/**
 * The zero-dependency default {@link AggregateStore}: a synchronized, insertion-ordered map keyed
 * on each aggregate's own identity. Insertion order makes {@code all()} — and so every generated
 * finder — deterministic. Runnable in tests out of the box.
 *
 * <p>Generated by Koine — do not edit by hand.</p>
 *
 * @param <I> the aggregate root's identity type
 * @param <T> the aggregate root type
 */
public final class InMemoryStore<I, T> implements AggregateStore<I, T> {
    private final java.util.Map<I, T> items = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final java.util.function.Function<T, I> identity;

    /** Creates a store that reads each aggregate's identity with {@code identity}. */
    public InMemoryStore(java.util.function.Function<T, I> identity) {
        this.identity = identity;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized java.util.Optional<T> get(I id) {
        return java.util.Optional.ofNullable(this.items.get(id));
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void add(T aggregate) {
        this.items.put(this.identity.apply(aggregate), aggregate);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void update(T aggregate) {
        this.items.put(this.identity.apply(aggregate), aggregate);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void remove(I id) {
        this.items.remove(id);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized java.util.List<T> all() {
        return java.util.List.copyOf(this.items.values());
    }
}

// ==== koine/runtime/IntegrationEventHandler.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.runtime;

/**
 * The delivery seam the generated {@code IntegrationEventDispatcher} hands each drained outbox row
 * to — publish it to a broker, POST it, or whatever the deployment calls for.
 *
 * <p>Generated by Koine — do not edit by hand.</p>
 */
public interface IntegrationEventHandler {
    /** Delivers one outbox row. Throwing leaves the row undelivered, so it is retried. */
    void handle(OutboxMessage message);
}

// ==== koine/runtime/OutboxMessage.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.runtime;

/**
 * One row of the transactional outbox: an integration event captured with its identity, type name,
 * and occurrence time, plus whether it has been delivered. Immutable — {@link #markProcessed()}
 * returns a new row rather than mutating this one.
 *
 * <p>Generated by Koine — do not edit by hand.</p>
 */
public record OutboxMessage(
        java.util.UUID id, String type, Object payload, java.time.Instant occurredOn, boolean processed) {
    /** Captures {@code integrationEvent} as a fresh, undelivered outbox row. */
    public static OutboxMessage of(Object integrationEvent) {
        return new OutboxMessage(
                java.util.UUID.randomUUID(),
                integrationEvent.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                integrationEvent,
                java.time.Instant.now(),
                false);
    }

    /** This row, marked delivered. */
    public OutboxMessage markProcessed() {
        return new OutboxMessage(this.id, this.type, this.payload, this.occurredOn, true);
    }
}

// ==== koine/runtime/OutboxStore.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.runtime;

/**
 * The transactional outbox's persistence seam. The producer appends a row inside its own
 * transaction; the generated {@code IntegrationEventDispatcher} drains the undelivered ones
 * out-of-band.
 *
 * <p>Generated by Koine — do not edit by hand.</p>
 */
public interface OutboxStore {
    /** Appends a row. */
    void add(OutboxMessage message);

    /** The undelivered rows, in the order they were appended, as an unmodifiable snapshot. */
    java.util.List<OutboxMessage> unprocessed();

    /** Marks the row with {@code message}'s identity delivered. A no-op when it is not stored. */
    void markProcessed(OutboxMessage message);
}

// ==== koine/runtime/Range.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.runtime;

/**
 * A closed interval {@code [start, end]} over a comparable type — the Java analogue of the Rust
 * runtime's {@code Range}. The {@code start()}/{@code end()} accessors are the record's own; the
 * caller is responsible for {@code start <= end} (a domain invariant).
 *
 * <p>Generated by Koine — do not edit by hand.</p>
 */
public record Range<T extends Comparable<? super T>>(T start, T end) {
    /** True when {@code value} lies within the closed interval {@code [start, end]}. */
    public boolean contains(T value) {
        return start.compareTo(value) <= 0 && value.compareTo(end) <= 0;
    }

    /** True when this interval and {@code other} share at least one point. */
    public boolean overlaps(Range<T> other) {
        return start.compareTo(other.end) <= 0 && other.start.compareTo(end) <= 0;
    }
}
